subject: Confidence intervals robust to non-normality and clustering using bootstrap

messages.author: 6313de06925845cc
messages.subject: Confidence intervals robust to non-normality and clustering using bootstrap
parts:
Hello,
I would like to know the code for confidence intervals that are  robust to non-normality and clustering using bootstrap in lavaan. Does the following code make sense:

FSFit <- sem(FS, missing = "fiml.x" , data = Fish_Dvlpt, se = "bootstrap", cluster = "Village" )

parameterEstimates(FSFit, boot.ci.type = "bca.simple")

Thank you so much,
Ranaivo
